name: What should I consider before contacting AKN Design Group for a patio project?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before contacting AKN Design Group for a patio project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group for a patio project, consider how you envision using the space and what primary functions it needs to serve. Think about the desired aesthetic, potential features like shade structures or an outdoor kitchen, and any preferences for materials. Having a general idea of your goals helps us better understand your needs during our initial consultation. While a detailed plan isn't necessary, thinking through these elements aids in our managed process from the outset, allowing us to develop a design that truly reflects your lifestyle and enhances your home's outdoor functionality and beauty. We also encourage homeowners to gather any inspiration images they may have.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider how you plan to use your patio, desired aesthetics, and any specific features you envision. This helps us understand your needs during the initial consultation.
